card.name: Words just before 'the moon'
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, to, of, the) in space-news text right before an expected mention of the Moon, such as after 'landing' or 'similar to the ones seen'.

modes.label: Linking word before moon
modes.description: A preposition or article that leads into 'the moon' or 'lunar surface' in a landing or crater comparison.
modes.example: In 1966, the Soviet probe Luna 9 became the first manmade object to make a soft landing<< on>> the moon.

modes.label: Other space-body descriptions
modes.description: Words in astronomy passages about planets or asteroids where the Moon is a likely comparison.
modes.example: You'll notice in the video that Vesta is<< not>> entirely lit up.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is Moon, moon or lunar, and lowers orbit-related words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word right before a likely mention of the Moon in space stories.
